name: PhotoCraft continuous retouch feedback formulas
additionalUpstream: Adapted clone sampling/composition, Poisson healing, coverage padding, spot-healing and tone/focus formulas from crates/engine/src/retouch_cmds.rs; sequential mixer/replacement paint from crates/paint/src/mixer.rs and replace.rs; nonseparable color helpers from crates/color/src/blend.rs, all at the pinned revision. Uses public paint renderers/dynamics and algorithm crates; streamed sample ownership, float working/carry state, provisional tails, resource budgets and cancellable leases are Orion adapters. Boundary-sensitive Smudge feedback uses the public Smudge API in crates/paint/src/retouch.rs; native source/composite sampling and stroke mixing are retained, with owned float tile checkpoints, dependency windows and bounded rewind/eviction. History Brush coverage/source-target lookup follows the pinned engine's retouch_cmds.rs and channel_cmds.rs; snapshot identifiers, weak source registry and trim/eviction validation are Orion-owned adapters over public native history APIs. Prepared retouch completion uses the public engine jobs API (crates/engine/src/jobs.rs) and native edit/history rules (lib.rs), clone response fields (retouch_cmds.rs), and final mixer carry conversion (crates/paint/src/mixer.rs). The guarded transfer, coalesced-history adapter and event draining are Orion-owned; the pinned engine and dependencies remain unchanged. Cooperative cancellation uses the pinned public raster Interrupt, algorithm inpaint::complete_with and poisson::membrane_fill_with APIs. The seamless clone adapter retains the native dst-minus-src boundary data and exact final mixing without an engine fork. Pre-raster primary/dual/tail geometry admission, transformed source bounds and shared dab budgets are Orion-owned. Sparse Clone/History Brush feedback uses the pinned public render::COV_TILE, StrokeRenderer::coverage_at and tail_preview APIs. Dirty primary/dual/tail patch ownership and restoration are Orion-owned; native source sampling/blending are retained through existing adapters. Sequential retouch working/visible state now uses Orion-owned 64-pixel copy-on-write float tiles, exact native per-dab/finite-halo regions, dirty opacity publication and immutable-source composition caching. Native tone/focus/mixer/replacement formulas remain in the existing adapted module; no intermediate integer quantization or engine fork. Smudge working/visible pixels and checkpoints now share the same Orion-owned 64-pixel float tiles with exact local carry windows clipped to full-prefix bounds. Dirty publication includes required native bounds strips to retain transparent-float opacity rounding; read-only publication does not retain untouched source tiles. Native Smudge carry/pickup formulas remain unchanged. Smudge carry-window summary indexing and incremental checkpoint pointer/reference accounting are Orion-owned metadata adapters. They retain the exact native clipping predicate, rewind eligibility and additional-payload eviction semantics, hold no extra float Arcs and cooperatively interrupt metadata scans. Healing/Spot Healing global coverage staging uses the same pinned public tail_preview and coverage_at APIs. Orion-owned region staging avoids full-renderer cloning and duplicate dense coverage buffers while preserving the complete native padded/context solve domain. Coverage rows observe cancellation; final publication installs document and damage together only after the last check. Native source/composite/solver formulas and the engine remain unchanged. Healing/Spot Healing publication uses the unchanged public paint::retouch::apply_coverage API on bounded 64-pixel patches; coverage extraction and restricted-channel restoration are Orion-owned cancellable adapters. Proximity search, deterministic SplitMix64, integral/hole geometry and texture synthesis are adapted from the same revision's crates/algo/src/inpaint.rs with unchanged candidate order, scoring, tie behavior and float math. Row/candidate/score/block/copy checks add cancellation; empty-source synthesis uses the public interruptible Poisson API. The full native solve domain and pinned engine remain unchanged. Healing solve staging in xdesign_photo_healing_solve.rs retains the pinned retouch_cmds.rs mask bounding/inflate/clamp and public interruptible Poisson semantics. Orion-owned strided difference/mask construction removes copied cropped source/destination regions, borrows the original destination instead of cloning full solved paint, and lazily overlays the exact corrected region in bounded publication patches. Mask/staging/mix/overlay rows observe cancellation; source and mask buffers are released before publication. The solve domain and native engine remain unchanged. Healing/Spot Healing source staging in xdesign_photo_healing_sources.rs preserves native current/below/all-layer visibility and the complete native compose/source regions. Orion-owned bounded reads, color encoding and destination resampling batches poll cancellation; affine batches call the unchanged public clone_source::resample against the complete sampled source. Chunk endpoint math is safe at integer limits. Composition and allocator calls remain individually uninterruptible; no source-domain cropping or engine fork. Ordinary Brush/Pencil/Eraser feedback in xdesign_photo_brush_feedback.rs uses the unchanged public engine LiveStroke API. Implicit mask/alpha/Quick Mask routing and single-color-channel restoration follow the pinned crates/engine/src/channel_cmds.rs; restoration uses bounded 64-pixel patches while retaining native changed-tile selection and pruning. Tool/target/symmetry/source guards and prepared transfer are Orion-owned; native brush math and the engine remain unchanged. Native image history persistence in xdesign_photo_history_persistence.rs uses the pinned public History APIs (crates/ops/src/lib.rs), format loaders/writers and raster Surface::put_tiles. Versioned snapshot references, weak source-ID/file bindings, metadata validation, public undo/redo reconstruction and exact-byte tile re-sharing are Orion-owned. Immutable publication, project undo/reopen, source choice persistence, portable export and startup reference protection retain native history semantics without an engine fork; no total native resource or device guarantee. Native image storage compaction uses public format ZIP/directory APIs from the same pinned revision. Startup scheduling, byte-for-byte entry manifests, original-ZIP recovery intents, guarded file-to-directory replacement, equal-object hardlink replacement, preflight and maintenance reporting are Orion-owned adapters. All version/source IDs and view metadata remain unchanged; native previews and opaque entries are preserved within the supported bundle layout. No engine fork, history deletion or total-resource guarantee.
